summary: The change removes empty-store administrator grants from password registration, password continuation, and passkey registration, and replaces them with an explicit one-time operator bootstrap plus regression coverage.

evidence: `src/passport.ts` 881-885 rejects every unauthenticated password registration before user creation.
`src/passport.ts` 988-1013 removes password-continuation account creation, and 1390-1394 denies all anonymous passkey finishes including challenges with legacy bootstrap flags.
`src/auth_store.ts` 968-980 and `scripts/bootstrap_admin.ts` 4-27 implement the sole operator-only bootstrap with an asserted email, non-terminal password input, and atomic one-time marker.

`tests/bun_test.ts` 1574-1798 covers passkey, password register, and password continue on empty user stores; `src/bootstrap_admin_test.ts` 19-103 covers marker non-reuse and concurrent one-winner behavior.
